Simple Roast Chicken
1 (4 lb) whole chicken, patted dry
2 tbsp butter, softened
1 lemon, halved
4 sprigs fresh thyme
1 head garlic, halved crosswise
2 tsp kosher salt
1 tsp black pepper
Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Rub the chicken all over with the butter and season with salt and pepper. Stuff the cavity with the lemon, thyme and garlic. Roast for 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes, until the juices run clear. Let rest for 15 minutes before carving.
